title: Turtle wearing sunglasses
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- Shell -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='58' rx='30' ry='22' fill='#2E8B57'/>
  <!-- Shell pattern -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='58' rx='22' ry='16' fill='#3CB371'/>
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='58' rx='13' ry='9' fill='#66CDAA'/>
  <!-- Shell rim -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='58' rx='30' ry='22' fill='none' stroke='#1B5E20' stroke-width='3'/>
  <!-- Legs -->
  <ellipse cx='25' cy='76' rx='8' ry='5' fill='#5DAA68'/>
  <ellipse cx='75' cy='76' rx='8' ry='5' fill='#5DAA68'/>
  <!-- Tail -->
  <polygon points='20,62 10,58 20,56' fill='#5DAA68'/>
  <!-- Head -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='32' rx='20' ry='15' fill='#6BCB77'/>
  <!-- Neck -->
  <rect x='42' y='42' width='16' height='12' fill='#6BCB77'/>
  <!-- Sunglasses frame -->
  <rect x='32' y='27' width='36' height='12' rx='4' fill='#333333'/>
  <!-- Lenses -->
  <rect x='35' y='29' width='13' height='8' rx='3' fill='#1A1A2E'/>
  <rect x='52' y='29' width='13' height='8' rx='3' fill='#1A1A2E'/>
  <!-- Lens shine -->
  <rect x='37' y='30' width='4' height='3' rx='1' fill='#4A4AFF' opacity='0.7'/>
  <rect x='54' y='30' width='4' height='3' rx='1' fill='#4A4AFF' opacity='0.7'/>
  <!-- Bridge -->
  <rect x='48' y='31' width='4' height='3' fill='#555555'/>
  <!-- Mouth -->
  <path d='M44 40 Q50 44 56 40' fill='none' stroke='#2E7D32' stroke-width='2' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- Nostrils -->
  <circle cx='46' cy='36' r='1' fill='#2E7D32'/>
  <circle cx='54' cy='36' r='1' fill='#2E7D32'/>
</svg>
